findings.reason: the author must add one ruling stating whether current.book subsumes observe_current_moments or why both remain (and name observation.py as retained or retired), otherwise the §6 import census has no rule to test the moment authority against and a duplicated moment path survives the retirement.
findings.text: §4's moment-map-derivative ruling names forward.py:1239-1302 as the owner moved into gs.apply, but observe_current_moments (observation.py:295) independently produces the same net-current and centroid from cell_current, and MomentIntegralSupport (observation.py:81) selects its core support; the design doc's destination for that row reads "current.book supplies the same moments and support receipt; retain observation formulae", which leaves two live producers of one set of current moments and no single named authority in the §3/§4/§6 text

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design puts one substantial function per module behind an interface far smaller than what it hides: topology.read collapses ~40 null/region authorities and an existing thin wrapper (Topology.read at topology.py:1396 already delegates to read_with_connectivity) into one module; solve.fixed_point hides Newton-GMRES, the line search and the per-step history behind one lax.scan call site; gs.apply hides the composed read-book-map and its three derivatives. This is consolidation of a 54,102-line sprawl into four deep modules, not a spread of wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4 declares gs.apply the single owner of the current-moment map and moves the derivative off forward.py, but nova/equilibrium/observation.py:295 (observe_current_moments) is a second producer of the same net+centroid moments, and the plan's §3/§4 prose never names its fate; the design doc's inventory binds it only loosely ("current.book supplies the same moments ... retain observation formulae").
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the sections that add surface account for it in the plan's own text — §6's Retirement paragraph and the request-surface ruling name SolveRoute collapsing from six literal members (nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py:27-34) to the one solve, SupportClipMode collapsing from three ("chord", "exact", "chord_cells") to the exact clip, the eight plumbing fields (active_set_steps, settled_exit, stagnation_stop, best_iterate_retention, continuation, own_mask_acceptance, warmup, step_cap) leaving ForwardSolvePolicy, and ~11 modules deleted; the two added policy operands (TopologyPolicy, SolvePolicy) are stated as carried by the existing ForwardSolvePolicy "extended rather than duplicated", so the three new modules and three functions net against a larger retirement rather than adding unaccounted surface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan runs an unfailable reuse map rather than asserting one: §1's design inventory binds 17 null-finding and 23 region-finding implementations to a destination each, and the plan carries eight cite-or-justify rulings that name exact symbols in exact files (topology.Topology.read/read_with_connectivity at nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1396/1376; ForwardFluxOperator.read/read_census/read_with_current_moments at nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:3166/1600/3191; the single-site GMRES kernel at fixed_point.py:2216/2371/2394/2619 and the backtracking helpers at fixed_point.py:1147/1270/1333; contour_tree.build_contour_tree at nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:384 and contour_tree_mesh.build_contour_mesh at contour_tree_mesh.py:193; polygon_moments.polygon_monomial_moments at nova/equilibrium/polygon_moments.py:141; the reduced-Newton step helpers at reduced_newton.py:970/976/990/767 and linearized_constraint_response_matrix at reduced_newton.py:2513; the clip helpers at clip_quadrature.py:415/714; the moment-map derivative at forward.py:1239/1276/1292). I opened each and confirmed the symbol exists at the cited module; the ruling that withdraws nova/biot/null.py as a null candidate (mesh-flux stitchers, not kernel derivatives) is correct on the file.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the new modules replace rather than wrap: §6 states gs.apply "replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs today rather than wrapping it", topology.read replaces Topology.read in place, and the regrown forward.py is justified in its own text as the consumer-facing request/receipt seam over ForwardProfile.operator, with the moment-map derivative moved out ("keeps no copy"). No proposed layer lacks its extend-vs-replace justification.
